variants.label: complemented one in a sum
variants.source:
pin 3 = a; pin 4 = b; pin 19 = y;
one = 'b'1; y = a # !one;
variants.reference:
pin 3 = a; pin 4 = b; pin 19 = y;
y = a;

variants.label: complemented zero in a product
variants.source:
pin 3 = a; pin 4 = b; pin 19 = y;
zero = 'b'0; y = a & !zero;
variants.reference:
pin 3 = a; pin 4 = b; pin 19 = y;
y = a;

variants.label: constant on the left
variants.source:
pin 3 = a; pin 4 = b; pin 19 = y;
one = 'b'1; y = !one # a;
variants.reference:
pin 3 = a; pin 4 = b; pin 19 = y;
y = a;

variants.label: nested complemented constants
variants.source:
pin 3 = a; pin 4 = b; pin 19 = y;
one = 'b'1; y = (a # !one) & (b # !one);
variants.reference:
pin 3 = a; pin 4 = b; pin 19 = y;
y = a & b;

variants.label: negated equation with a complemented constant
variants.source:
pin 3 = a; pin 4 = b; pin 19 = y;
one = 'b'1; y = !(a # !one);
variants.reference:
pin 3 = a; pin 4 = b; pin 19 = y;
y = !a;
